bot_config {"Rand": 1}

join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!roll
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 2


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 100
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 88

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 8

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 20

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!random coin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Tails!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!random coin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Heads!


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 1d50
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 26

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 3d10
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 1, 7, 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll -3d10
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 15

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 3d-99
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 12

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 chatter-display=FooBar :!roll 99d99
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FooBar rolled: 22, 12, 68, 18, 19, 39

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!roll
no_send


clock_forward 10m

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!roll
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random rolled: 18

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!roll
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set cooldown 30
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set roll cooldown 1
send_any

clock_forward 10m

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!roll
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random rolled: 7

clock_forward 3s

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!roll
no_send
